// A tutor and the card it fetches, plus enough blue mana to cast it.

// Twelve cards: Trinket Mage costs {2}{U}, so three Islands is the earliest it
// resolves, and the single Lantern of Insight is the card it goes and gets.
// The two criteria files beside this one ask the same questions of this deck
// and differ only in whether the tutor is declared.
4x Island [Land]
1x Trinket Mage [Tutor]
1x Lantern of Insight [Lantern - Vision]
6x Lightning Bolt [Burn]
